title: Removal of a Cockpit Windshield Assembly
abstract: Removal of one cockpit windshield assembly, covering the heater isolation, the retainer removal sequence and the handling precautions that protect the glass edge and the frame sealing land.

sections.purpose: This task removes one cockpit windshield assembly from its frame so that it can be replaced, and leaves the frame sealing land in a condition that will accept the replacement window.
sections.job_setup_note: The windshield weighs about 30 kilograms and is awkward to handle from inside the flight compartment; two people and the suction handling frame are required. The heater circuit must be isolated at the circuit breaker and proved dead, because the bus is live on external power. Protect the glareshield and the instrument panel before you start; a dropped retainer will damage both.
sections.procedure: 1. Remove external power, isolate the window heat circuit at the circuit breaker and prove the terminal dead. WARNING: THE WINDOW HEAT BUS CARRIES A HIGH CURRENT AND IS LIVE ON EXTERNAL POWER. PROVE THE TERMINAL DEAD BEFORE YOU DISCONNECT THE HEATER TERMINATION. 2. Cover the glareshield and the instrument panel with the protective mat. 3. Get access from inside the flight compartment in zones 211, 214 and 215. 4. Disconnect the heater termination and the sensing leads at FIN 1WX and FIN 1981WX and label them. 5. Remove the internal trim and the retainer screws, working from the top down. 6. Remove the blind rivets AES757493-5D that hold the retainer strip. CAUTION: DO NOT LET THE DRILL CONTACT THE GLASS EDGE. A SINGLE SCRATCH ON THE EDGE WILL START A DELAMINATION. 7. Fit the suction handling frame to the outer face of the windshield. 8. Cut the sealant bead around the perimeter with the non-metallic knife. 9. With two people, push the windshield outward and take its weight on the handling frame. 10. Inspect the frame sealing land, the splice plate D5610114829453 and the spar cap D5610115011532 for corrosion and record the condition. 11. Clean the old sealant from the land with a plastic scraper.
sections.close_out: Fit the temporary blank to the aperture if the aircraft is to be left. Keep the removed windshield in its transport frame with the edges protected. Record the windshield part number, the hours since installation and the reason for removal on the component removal card. Leave the window heat circuit breaker collared and the warning notice in place.

safety_precautions: Prove the window heat terminal dead before you disconnect it.
Two people are required to handle the windshield.
Protect the glareshield and the instrument panel.
Do not let any tool contact the glass edge.
